  path={"/api/update_user/{name}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Updates the named user's display name, email, SSH key, and roles, and
optionally sets a new password if one is provided.

Doubles as the self-service profile edit: any user may update their own
display name, email, SSH key, and password without the 'Manage users'
permission. Editing someone else's account, or changing role assignments
at all - including one's own - requires it, since otherwise every user
could grant themselves any permission.
